method.zh: 影片觀察、本人說法與設計推論分開標示。跨期文字來源可支持調整方向；跨期動作結論仍需至少兩支實看影片。未播放的片源不附時間碼或動作判斷。
method.en: Footage, testimony and design inference are labeled separately. Cross-era text supports directions; motion changes still require at least two viewed videos. Unplayed sources carry no fabricated timestamps or observations.

summary.zh: 原報導支持早期已有變化發球、主動擰拉與正手反拉。第三板會依回球高度選擇；本期比賽片源尚未逐段播放比較。
summary.en: Reports describe varied service, attacking flicks and forehand counters already present, with third-ball selection by return height. Match-footage comparison remains pending.

observation.zh: 2019 年技術報導：較高拋球配合兩次引拍，長短發球準備外形相近。
observation.en: The 2019 technical report describes a higher toss, two preparations and similar short/long service setups.

inference.zh: 發球動畫應保留拋球、引拍與揮拍的連續節奏。球速與長度要在最後接觸改變，單看起手不應提前揭露答案。
inference.en: Animate toss and preparation continuously; vary contact and length without revealing the outcome in the initial setup.

title.zh: 林昀儒兩段式發球引拍

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 2019 年原始報導已把大膽擰拉列為特色。擰拉是在球台內用反手先上手的接法。
observation.en: The 2019 report already identifies an aggressive table flick as a distinguishing receive.

inference.zh: 早期角色也需要主動接發，不能等到後期才開放這項技術。使用率仍待完整比賽核對。
inference.en: An early-era role can attack receives; match-wide usage still needs verification.

title.zh: 林昀儒早期打法與本人訪談

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 2020 年本人技術解說：低搓長先拉旋轉，高回球才強攻。
observation.en: His 2020 explanation distinguishes spin opening against low pushes from stronger attacks on high returns.

inference.zh: 發球後需讀回球高度，再選起板或強攻，避免固定第三板力道。
inference.en: Choose a spin opening or power attack from return height rather than a fixed third-ball force.

title.zh: 林昀儒發球後的第三板

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 同篇已記錄長發球後側身正手反拉的選項。
observation.en: That report already includes a pivot forehand counter after a long serve.

inference.zh: 早期也有正手進攻。比較成長時應看使用條件與銜接品質，不能寫成後期才學會正手。
inference.en: Early play includes forehands; later comparisons should examine selection and transitions.

title.zh: 林昀儒發球後的第三板

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 同篇 2019 年報導記錄高速回合中的放鬆反帶。
observation.en: The same 2019 report describes relaxed counters in fast rallies.

inference.zh: 快速反帶的準備與還原應短，連續回合不宜每板都做大引拍。
inference.en: Use compact preparation and recovery for fast counters.

title.zh: 林昀儒早期打法與本人訪談

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 長發球後會留出空間，準備較快的進攻接發。
observation.en: After a long serve, he creates space for a fast attacking receive.

inference.zh: 離台距離應隨發球預期改變。角色若始終貼著台沿，下一板容易只靠伸臂。
inference.en: Adjust table distance to the expected receive so the next shot does not rely solely on arm reach.

title.zh: 林昀儒發球後的第三板

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

comparisonLimits.zh: 同一時期不同對手、來球、局面與轉播角度會改變選擇。比較需按球種和回合階段對齊。
comparisonLimits.en: Opponent, incoming ball, score and camera change shot selection. Align ball types and rally stages before comparing eras.

serve.zh: 需分短／長、發球後站位與還原，影像無法可靠看出的旋轉保持未知。
serve.en: Separate short/long service, post-service position and recovery; retain unknown spin where unclear.

receive.zh: 需核對擺短、搓長、擰拉的来球條件，避免只抽成功精華。
receive.en: Check incoming-ball conditions for stops, long pushes and flicks without sampling successful highlights only.

thirdBall.zh: 按回球高度、長度與旋轉線索比較起板選擇。
thirdBall.en: Compare opening choices by return height, length and visible spin cues.

forehand.zh: 比較到位、引拍、擊球、收拍與下一板，不以單板幅度代表威力。
forehand.en: Compare positioning through recovery; swing size alone does not establish power.

backhand.zh: 分台內擰拉、長球起板、反帶與擋球，避免混成一種反手。
backhand.en: Separate table flicks, openings, counters and blocks.

transition.zh: 記錄換正反手之前腳步與換完後空出的區域。
transition.en: Record footwork before switching and exposed space afterward.

footwork.zh: 觀察啟動、側步、到位與還原，腳被遮住時不推測接地。
footwork.en: Observe initiation, steps, positioning and recovery without inferring hidden foot contacts.

distance.zh: 離台距離需按同一回合階段比較，不從單張鏡頭估算公尺。
distance.en: Compare distance at matched rally stages without estimating metres from a single view.

placement.zh: 需要可追球的前後畫面，別從收拍方向猜落點。
placement.en: Use visible ball trajectories before and after contact, not follow-through direction alone.

offenseDefense.zh: 記錄被壓制、擋回、重新上手的條件，結果得分不等於每板主動。
offenseDefense.en: Record pressure, blocking and re-entry into attack; a won point does not make every shot offensive.

summary.zh: 已整理休士頓世錦賽、薩格勒布與阿拉木圖等官方片源，但此期尚未實看。不能把前後兩期文字描述直接填入本期。
summary.en: Official Houston, Zagreb and Almaty sources are listed but unobserved. Descriptions from adjacent eras cannot establish this era’s style.

summary.zh: 本人解說的重點是接發選擇與腳步到位：擰拉仍重要，同時增加擺短和速推。這是文字支持的調整，本輪影片比較待核。
summary.en: His explanations emphasize receive choice and positioning: retain the flick while adding stops and fast pushes. This is testimony-supported; footage comparison is pending.

observation.zh: 2023 年本人說法蘭克福增加擺短、速推。對手等擰拉或球太外側時改接法。
observation.en: In 2023 he described adding stops and fast pushes when opponents anticipated a flick or served too wide.

inference.zh: 可依來球位置與對手站位切換接法，保留相近的靠近來球動作。
inference.en: Switch receives with ball and opponent position while retaining similar approach movements.

title.zh: 從擰拉依賴到接發球組合
title.en: From flick reliance to receive combinations

limits.zh: 本人描述特定賽事的調整，沒有證明每一場都採用相同比例。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 2023 年本人解說擰拉：快前臂帶動，手腕在末段少量控制。
observation.en: His 2023 flick explanation emphasizes a fast forearm and a small final wrist adjustment.

inference.zh: 台內擰拉要有獨立姿勢，肘、前臂與拍面一起運動，不能只轉手腕。
inference.en: Give the table flick a distinct elbow, forearm and racket motion.

title.zh: 林昀儒本人解說擰拉

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 先移到球在身體正面，左腳前踏並前傾，擊球後回接發位置。
observation.en: He moves the ball in front of the body, steps in left-foot first, leans and returns to receive position.

inference.zh: 要先到位再揮拍。靠伸長手臂補距離會破壞固定骨長，也表現不出回位。
inference.en: Move before swinging and recover through footwork rather than extending limb length.

title.zh: 林昀儒本人解說擰拉

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 本人說直線擰拉需留弧線，並更快準備被打回空出的反手側。
observation.en: He describes more arc on the down-line flick and faster readiness for the exposed backhand side.

inference.zh: 落點選擇應同時改變下一板的站位成本，避免把直線當成無代價加分。
inference.en: Placement choices should carry a recovery cost rather than grant a cost-free advantage.

title.zh: 林昀儒本人解說擰拉

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 速推以前臂伸出、較少手腕為主，重視早點和球速。
observation.en: His fast push emphasizes an early contact, forearm extension and limited wrist.

inference.zh: 推球也能讓對手少一點準備時間，不能把每次推球都設成被動讓分。
inference.en: A push can deny preparation time; it need not always surrender initiative.

summary.zh: 目前只有 Doha 2026 單一重播回合可驗證低重心、側步與持拍手準備位置，尚不足以代表此時期打法。
summary.en: A single Doha 2026 replay verifies low stance, side steps and racket readiness; it does not establish a representative era style.

observation.zh: 近端橘衣左手選手林昀儒在 5:01、5:03 保持屈膝、寬站距與上身前傾，持拍手在身體前方。5:04 追向側邊來球，兩腿展開、軀幹橫向移動，持拍臂向前；不是站直後只擺手臂。
observation.en: Near-side Lin, orange shirt and left-handed, stays flexed with a wide base and forward trunk at 5:01 and 5:03, with the racket in front. At 5:04 he reaches a lateral ball with a widened leg position, trunk translation and forward racket arm rather than remaining upright.

inference.zh: 遊戲可把準備姿勢維持在低重心，側移時讓腳、骨盆與軀幹一起改變位置。這是動畫設計參考，不能等同林昀儒整場打法。
inference.en: The animation can preserve a low ready stance and coordinate feet, pelvis and trunk during lateral movement. This is a design reference, not a whole-match style conclusion.

limits.zh: 重播與三張影格只支持定性姿勢／步法；球台遮擋與動態模糊限制了接觸點判讀。
limits.en: Replay and three stills support qualitative posture and footwork only. Table occlusion and motion blur limit contact identification.

limits.zh: 不能由此估算擊球比例、旋轉、速度、精確關節角或跨期變化。
limits.en: No shot rate, spin, velocity, exact joint angle or era change can be estimated.

title.zh: 接發球增加選項

observation.zh: 2019 年原報導已記錄擰拉。2023 年本人明說增加擺短和速推來改變對手準備。
observation.en: The 2019 report identifies the flick; in 2023 he explicitly described adding stops and fast pushes.

inference.zh: 可確認的調整方向是接法組合增加。技術是否更快、使用率差多少，仍待同條件比賽比較。
inference.en: The documented direction is broader selection; speed and usage changes still need matched match evidence.

title.zh: 林昀儒早期打法與本人訪談
從擰拉依賴到接發球組合
title.en: From flick reliance to receive combinations

limits.zh: 兩個文字來源支持方向，尚沒有兩支跨期影片實看證據。
limits.en: Two text sources support the direction; two-era viewed-video evidence is absent.

summary.zh: 近台早點反手已有原始比賽報導支持，正手相持也已存在。單場報導不能代表整個早期使用率；多場影片待核。
summary.en: A primary report supports early close-table backhands and existing forehand exchanges. One match cannot establish era-wide usage; multiple videos remain unobserved.

observation.zh: 報導提到第二局從自己的發球展開創造機會。
observation.en: The report notes chances created from his own service sequence in game two.

inference.zh: 發球後要立刻回到下一板準備，具體球種和頻率仍未驗證。
inference.en: Recover immediately after service; specific service types and frequencies remain unverified.

title.zh: 張本早期的近台搶點

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 同場報導也記錄正手側的相持與決勝局強攻失誤。
observation.en: The same report records forehand exchanges and deciding-game attack errors.

inference.zh: 早期角色仍需正手相持。某局失誤不能變成永久缺少這項技術。
inference.en: Retain early forehand exchanges; errors in one game do not establish absence of a skill.

title.zh: 張本早期的近台搶點

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 2017 年對奧恰洛夫的原報導記錄近台早點反手掌握回合。
observation.en: The 2017 Ovtcharov report documents early close-table backhands controlling rallies.

inference.zh: 特色可表現在較早接球與短還原，不能只增加反手球速。
inference.en: Express this through early contact and compact recovery, not speed alone.

title.zh: 張本早期的近台搶點

limits.zh: 單場現場報導，尚無多場實看片段支持頻率或普遍性。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 原報導把早點反手放在近台位置描述。
observation.en: The report explicitly locates the early backhand exchanges close to the table.

inference.zh: 近台需要縮短手臂行程和回位時間，但不能把他固定在同一條站位線。
inference.en: Close-table play needs short arm travel and recovery without a fixed positioning line.

title.zh: 張本早期的近台搶點

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

comparisonLimits.zh: 同一時期不同對手、來球、局面與轉播角度會改變選擇。比較需按球種和回合階段對齊。
comparisonLimits.en: Opponent, incoming ball, score and camera change shot selection. Align ball types and rally stages before comparing eras.

serve.zh: 需分短／長、發球後站位與還原，影像無法可靠看出的旋轉保持未知。
serve.en: Separate short/long service, post-service position and recovery; retain unknown spin where unclear.

receive.zh: 需核對擺短、搓長、擰拉的来球條件，避免只抽成功精華。
receive.en: Check incoming-ball conditions for stops, long pushes and flicks without sampling successful highlights only.

thirdBall.zh: 按回球高度、長度與旋轉線索比較起板選擇。
thirdBall.en: Compare opening choices by return height, length and visible spin cues.

forehand.zh: 比較到位、引拍、擊球、收拍與下一板，不以單板幅度代表威力。
forehand.en: Compare positioning through recovery; swing size alone does not establish power.

backhand.zh: 分台內擰拉、長球起板、反帶與擋球，避免混成一種反手。
backhand.en: Separate table flicks, openings, counters and blocks.

transition.zh: 記錄換正反手之前腳步與換完後空出的區域。
transition.en: Record footwork before switching and exposed space afterward.

footwork.zh: 觀察啟動、側步、到位與還原，腳被遮住時不推測接地。
footwork.en: Observe initiation, steps, positioning and recovery without inferring hidden foot contacts.

distance.zh: 離台距離需按同一回合階段比較，不從單張鏡頭估算公尺。
distance.en: Compare distance at matched rally stages without estimating metres from a single view.

placement.zh: 需要可追球的前後畫面，別從收拍方向猜落點。
placement.en: Use visible ball trajectories before and after contact, not follow-through direction alone.

offenseDefense.zh: 記錄被壓制、擋回、重新上手的條件，結果得分不等於每板主動。
offenseDefense.en: Record pressure, blocking and re-entry into attack; a won point does not make every shot offensive.

summary.zh: 已整理 Doha、新加坡、新鄉與澳門片源，本期尚未實看。成績與標題不足以判定動作或戰術進步。
summary.en: Doha, Singapore, XinXiang and Macao sources are listed but unobserved. Results and titles do not establish motion or tactical improvement.

summary.zh: 2023 年本人自評更重視穩定性，也明說正反手銜接與短球仍有改善空間。這是其自評，還不能定位每個動作改變的時點。
summary.en: His 2023 self-assessment stresses consistency, forehand–backhand links and short play. It does not locate the timing of every technical change.

observation.zh: 本人說對梁靖崑擺短互鬥時，自己先搓長而被進攻。
observation.en: He described conceding the short-touch exchange to Liang Jingkun by pushing long first.

inference.zh: 接發判斷要包含短球耐心，搓長之後需準備被起板。
inference.en: Model patience in short play and readiness for an opening attack after a long push.

title.zh: 張本對穩定性與正反手銜接的自評
title.en: Harimoto on consistency and linking strokes

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 他自述反手很有信心，也指出反手相持贏球不保證整場勝利。
observation.en: He expressed confidence in his backhand while noting that winning those exchanges does not win the whole match.

inference.zh: 反手優勢需要接發與正手銜接配合，不能直接變成全局命中率。
inference.en: A backhand strength needs receive and forehand support rather than a global accuracy bonus.

title.zh: 張本對穩定性與正反手銜接的自評
title.en: Harimoto on consistency and linking strokes

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 本人指出單板能做，但正手各技術與反手連動仍有課題。
observation.en: He distinguished executing an isolated shot from linking forehand techniques with his backhand.

inference.zh: 動作示範要包含換面與回位，單獨展示漂亮的一板不足以表現連續打法。
inference.en: Demonstrate switching and recovery as well as isolated strokes.

title.zh: 張本對穩定性與正反手銜接的自評
title.en: Harimoto on consistency and linking strokes

limits.zh: 本人解說／原始報導，尚未用本輪比賽播放逐段核對。
limits.en: Testimony or original report, not independently checked against match playback in this stage.

observation.zh: 2023 年本人說减少勉強進攻，但有時擋太多，仍需當下換戰術。
observation.en: In 2023 he described fewer forced attacks, sometimes excessive blocking and a need to change tactics.

inference.zh: 短擋應連到下一板準備，有空間才轉進攻。任何失誤率改善都未在此量測。
inference.en: Link blocks to recovery and attack when space permits; no error-rate improvement is measured here.

summary.zh: 目前只有 Doha 2026 單一重播回合可驗證低重心、側步與持拍手準備位置，尚不足以代表此時期打法。
summary.en: A single Doha 2026 replay verifies low stance, side steps and racket readiness; it does not establish a representative era style.

observation.zh: 遠端藍衣右手選手張本智和同樣屈膝前傾，雙腳分開。5:03–5:04 站位隨回合橫向調整，持拍手留在軀幹前方；遠端球台遮住部分腿部與擊球細節。
observation.en: Far-side Harimoto, blue shirt and right-handed, also uses flexed knees, a forward lean and separated feet. At 5:03–5:04 his position adjusts laterally with the rally and his racket stays ahead of the trunk. The far table obscures parts of his legs and contact detail.

inference.zh: 可用短側步與面向來球的還原來表現連續準備，避免擊球後手臂長時間停在終點。不能由這段判定他全程更近台或反手比例較高。
inference.en: Short side steps and recovery toward the incoming ball can express continuous readiness rather than a long held finish. This interval cannot establish a closer-table style or a higher backhand share.

limits.zh: 重播與三張影格只支持定性姿勢／步法；球台遮擋與動態模糊限制了接觸點判讀。
limits.en: Replay and three stills support qualitative posture and footwork only. Table occlusion and motion blur limit contact identification.

limits.zh: 不能由此估算擊球比例、旋轉、速度、精確關節角或跨期變化。
limits.en: No shot rate, spin, velocity, exact joint angle or era change can be estimated.

title.zh: 更重視穩定性與下一板

observation.zh: 2017 年報導描述早點反手搶先。2023 年本人說更少勉強進攻，並加強正反手連動。
observation.en: A 2017 report describes early backhand initiative; his 2023 self-assessment stresses fewer forced attacks and stronger links.

inference.zh: 這支持決策和連續打法的訓練方向，不能據此宣稱反手減少或站位固定退後。
inference.en: This supports a training and decision direction, not a measured reduction in backhands or a permanent retreat.

title.zh: 張本早期的近台搶點
張本對穩定性與正反手銜接的自評
title.en: Harimoto on consistency and linking strokes

limits.zh: 早期是單場報導，後期是本人自評。影片比較尚未完成。
limits.en: An early single-match report and later self-assessment; footage comparison is incomplete.

title.zh: 近期正手強化的本人說法

observation.zh: 2023 年訪談把正手與反手連動列為課題。日期未明的官方產品頁引言說近年正手對拉強化後，反手依賴降低。
observation.en: The 2023 interview identifies forehand links as a task; an undated official product quote describes stronger forehand exchanges and less backhand dependence.

inference.zh: 可用來設定待驗證的正手銜接方向，不能定位成 2025 或 2026 某場才發生的改變。
inference.en: Use this as a hypothesis for forehand links, without assigning the change to a particular 2025 or 2026 match.

title.zh: 張本對穩定性與正反手銜接的自評
title.en: Harimoto on consistency and linking strokes

title.zh: 張本本人談近年的正手強化

limits.zh: 後一來源含產品行銷，日期與改善幅度不明，沒有量測。
limits.en: The later source is a marketing testimonial with unknown date and unmeasured improvement.

observation.zh: 同一 Doha 重播中，林的左手與張本的右手姿勢方向不同，兩人都有屈膝前傾、寬站距與隨回合橫向調整。
observation.en: In the same Doha replay, Lin’s left-handed and Harimoto’s right-handed arrangements differ, while both show flexion, forward lean, a wide base and lateral adjustment.

inference.zh: 動畫可共用到位與還原的基本結構，持拍側及個人接法另處理。
inference.en: Animation can share positioning and recovery principles while handling handedness and receives separately.

limits.zh: 同一回合不能比較整體風格、力量或兩人各球種使用率。
limits.en: One rally cannot establish overall style, power or shot distributions.

globalLimits.zh: 轉播視角、對手球路、比分與球桌遮擋會混雜動作比較；不從2D影像推算精確3D關節角、旋轉或比例。
globalLimits.en: Camera, opponent, score and table occlusion confound comparisons; no exact 3D angles, spin or rates are inferred.

globalLimits.zh: 目前只有一個近期重播回合，尚未完成跨時期實看比較。本人訪談支持的变化需另標来源，不算新增觀看片段。
globalLimits.en: Only one recent replay interval has been observed; cross-era viewing is incomplete. Changes supported by testimony are labeled separately and do not add viewed segments.
